execution_steps.name: Semantic Authorization
execution_steps.actions: Evaluates semantic requirements, issues AuthorityDecision.ALLOW, mints CapabilityLease with explicit intent fingerprint, scope, and contract hash.

execution_steps.name: Request Construction & Entry Dispatch
execution_steps.actions: Constructs typed mutation request (PlanInitRequest / PlanRetirementRequest) with TrustedContext, Lease, Intent, and Preconditions.

execution_steps.name: Ingress Validation & Lease Verification
execution_steps.actions: Validates inputs against OperationContractDescriptor, verifies lease signature/scope/time via CapabilityLeaseIssuer, derives complete identity.

execution_steps.name: Local Subject Transition
execution_steps.actions: Executes local subject graph transition in TransactionStore with CAS revision checks; stages mutations.

execution_steps.name: Durable Journal Reservation
execution_steps.actions: Creates PREPARED record in DurableJournalStore (rev 1), executes atomic CAS transition to APPLYING (rev 2) holding at-most-one attempt reservation.

execution_steps.name: External Authority Mutation
execution_steps.actions: Executes read-before-write to verify raw authority precondition, performs single typed mutation attempt on external target.

execution_steps.name: Verify-After-Write Readback
execution_steps.actions: Re-reads authoritative raw target to obtain observed revision and observed raw digest; transport success alone does not imply VERIFIED.

execution_steps.name: Three-Way Classification & Terminal CAS
execution_steps.actions: Classifies observed state (candidate -> VERIFIED, original -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT/RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT, third -> CONFLICT, timeout/read-fail -> OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/RECONCILING) and commits terminal journal CAS.

execution_steps.name: Canonical Result Projection
execution_steps.actions: Projects LifecycleResult envelope and maps exit code deterministically.

transaction_boundaries.local_graph_boundary: TransactionStore CAS transaction on Subject graph records
transaction_boundaries.durable_journal_boundary: DurableJournalStore per-record CAS transaction on journal entries
transaction_boundaries.external_authority_boundary: External target write (GitHub Issue body / control comment)
transaction_boundaries.cross_boundary_atomicity: Explicitly unavailable; coordinated mechanically via PREPARED->APPLYING journal CAS and readback verification
